column_description: VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY uniquely identifying each inverter record.
UUID REFERENCES Plant(GrowRegistry), indicating which plant’s inverter we are tracking.
TIMESTAMP noting when this inverter reading was taken (e.g., '2023-07-15 10:40:00').
NUMERIC(7,3) the AC grid voltage in volts (was 'GridVoltageV') (e.g., 400.000).
DECIMAL(7,3) the AC grid frequency in Hz (was 'GridFrequencyHz') (e.g., 50.050).

JSONB column. Stores key performance metrics related to the inverter's power output and quality, including efficiency, power factor, and harmonic distortion.
Fields: {"harmdistpct":"DECIMAL(7,3) total harmonic distortion in percent (was 'HarmonicDistortionPercent') (e.g., 3.500).","inverteffpct":"DECIMAL(7,3) the inverter efficiency percentage (was 'InverterEfficiencyPercent') (e.g., 98.500).","invertpowfac":"NUMERIC(7,3) the inverter’s power factor (was 'InverterPowerFactor') (e.g., 0.990).","reacpwrkvar":"DECIMAL(7,2) reactive power output in kVAR (was 'ReactivePowerKVAR') (e.g., 10.00)."}
